facts.text: Hook and line from the knife handle
facts.why: Rambo never fishes in the film. What comes out of the knife handle is a needle and thread, which he uses to stitch his own arm after the cliff fall. Only the Fandom page says hook and line, and it says that was for the stitches, not for catching fish.
facts.fix: Rambo lives off the land in the Hope woods

facts.text: Trautman says he'll eat things that would make a billy goat puke.
facts.why: As printed it reads as Trautman saying he himself will eat them. Trautman is describing Rambo: a man trained to live off the land and eat things that would make a billy goat puke.
facts.fix: Trautman says Rambo eats things that would make a billy goat puke.

notes: Hog settled: Outdoorhub confirms Rambo kills a wild hog with his knife spear, matching the Fandom page. Stitches settled: needle and thread from the handle (Bamfstyle, Coffee or Die), not hook and line, and no fishing scene.

vibe.verdict: A real search party mess with the radio line, the diner, the billy goat and the hog all landing, but the trout note claims a fishing scene the film doesn't have.
